'''Shep Contopault''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. He was known as a criminal to the [[Sector Ranger/Legends|Sector Rangers]], and served as a confidential informant.<ref name="Secrets of Naboo" />

Later a reformed criminal, he formed the [[Free Trader Association of Naboo]] in an attempt to become a legitimate businessman and leave his shady past behind him. Contopault was fluent in both [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] and [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]].<ref name="Secrets of Naboo" />
